name: sol8-contract-column-fit
goal: Keep contract table labels readable beside long identifiers and types

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Metadata columns in 407f1ab711 leave desktop long identifiers/types unbroken, compressing Requirement and Default words. API long-desktop at 59ec4969c4 shows fragmented short labels.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The existing shared guard checks text presence and bounds, but not fragmentation into character-sized lines. Extend its normal contract viewport matrix with whole-word heading and requirement checks.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint e4f1fcd8de fails desktop long-field label readability in the unchanged three-viewport command; immutable failing captures are retained.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Wrap long names/types, reserve readable short labels through intrinsic widths and nowrap headers, and keep the existing stacked narrow layout.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: f91703d07e wraps long identifiers/types within their cells, preserves intrinsic short-label widths and keeps table headings on one line.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged three-viewport long-field command passes at f91703d07e; record 0a7349e479c45e3d53de9e14a60f69ece05406b86308403e50da16d2a6366152 retains all three captures.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: Isolated committed snapshots reject fragmented labels before repair and accept the unchanged guard after repair. The guard runs across every existing contract component catalog state.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
